question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

He was __compelled__ by everyone to join the group.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Dissuaded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• "**Compelled**" **means forced or pressured to do something.(**मजबूर)
 
 
• Example: Her family compelled her to take the job.
 
 
 
• **"Dissuaded" means being discouraged or advised against doing something**.(रोक)
 
 
• Example: He was finally dissuaded to ignore the matter.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, it can be concluded that the word "dissuaded" is the antonym of "compelled."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Demur** means to object or hesitate.(आपत्ति)
 
• **Obscured **means to make unclear or difficult to understand.(अस्पष्ट करना)
 
• **Confessed** means to admit or acknowledge a wrongdoing.(स्वीकार करना)
